sources: Donald Trump interview with Right Side Broadcasting Network (RSBN), Sunday Nov 1, via Al Jazeera liveblog + Times of Israel + Israel National News
fault_line: Deal now, or the 'easy way' after Tuesday -- is this a real deadline, or another predicted end that slips past the midterms?

sections.what_happened: Trump: 'We've had such a victory and we'll put it away very soon, one way or the other. Either they'll make a deal or we'll just end it, end it the, I guess you could say, maybe the easy way.' Same appearance confirms the 'very good talk' with Netanyahu (0100-02) and repeats the Pickaxe Mountain warning: 'We can do that in 10 minutes. We have that planned.' This is NEW wording vs 0100-02 (which carried only the 'very good talk' confirmation and the Axios timing-split report). Context: Axios (via ToI/INN) says Netanyahu pressed for strikes immediately after the Nov 3 midterms while Trump favoured letting Qatar-mediated talks play out; Saturday Trump said talks were 'going fine' and he was 'not in that much of a hurry.'
sections.what_verified: Same RSBN quotes carried verbatim by Al Jazeera liveblog, Times of Israel, and Israel National News. INN carries no declared tier in the registry, so it is attributed reporting only and NOT counted toward corroboration.
sections.what_disputed: Times of Israel notes Trump 'has been claiming that the Iran war would imminently end since just a few weeks into the conflict' (began Feb 28) and recently predicted a swift end after the midterms -- the 'very soon' deadline has slipped repeatedly. Saturday's own 'not in that much of a hurry' line cuts against the Sunday ultimatum tone. Neither the White House nor the Prime Minister's Office commented on the Axios timing-split report.
sections.why_matters: Trump's own deadline, in his own words: deal, or 'we'll just end it -- maybe the easy way' -- and he names the target he says takes 10 minutes. Proven-set Trump-Iran endgame, fresh quotes only; narration must not re-tell 0100-02.
sections.context: Background: MISSED CATCH-UP / UPDATE-DETAIL to 0100-02 -- Trump RSBN ultimatum: Iran will 'make a deal or we'll just end it, maybe the easy way'; Pickaxe Mountain named as 10-minute target
